快捷键和光标切换都使用此游戏的专用规则。关闭后可恢复全局规则。: Shortcuts and cursor switching both use this game’s rules. Turn this off to use the global rules again.
为这个游戏创建第一份配置。: Create the first profile for this game.
此分组还没有配置。: This group has no profiles yet.
配置将移到「未归类」，该游戏的专用切换规则将移除。: The profiles will move to Unassigned and this game’s switching rules will be removed.
移动后，原游戏中指向这些配置的专用切换规则会移除。: Moving a profile removes any rules in its previous game that target it.
运行时按正在使用的配置所属游戏选择规则。: Rules follow the game that owns the profile running in the engine.
此游戏使用全局规则。: This game inherits the global rules.
切换目标必须属于当前游戏: Switch targets must belong to this game
游戏名称应为 1 到 100 个字符: Game names must contain 1 to 100 characters
已有同名游戏: A game with this name already exists
配置只能属于一个游戏: A profile can only belong to one game
游戏引用的配置无效: The game refers to an invalid profile
